historical_outcomes.description: unresolved, self-referential, circular, or chained cross-reference

historical_outcomes.description: systematic named-entity, example, or citation clutter
historical_outcomes.finding: The full locator audit records 235 attribution-only or incidental-example access points across all 17 chapters, a systematic clutter pattern.

No critical or major grounding item remains unresolved. Seven localized, high-confidence locator/benchmark dependency conflicts were retained without reinterpretation and disclosed for centralized adjudication.

historical_outcomes.description: more than 1% of in-scope locator assignments uninspectable without a frozen alternative tolerance
historical_outcomes.finding: All 5,338 assignments were inspectable; the uninspectable rate is 0%, below the frozen 1% tolerance.
The frozen page map and 17-chapter manifest cover supplied document pages 1-425 exactly once, and every candidate locator resolves within that span.
The canonical outputs are structurally complete: 1,904/1,904 nodes, 16/16 references, 5,338/5,338 locators, and 1,366/1,366 benchmark subjects are present and uniquely graded.
